allocation_method: One warmed untimed batch; count allocation and reallocation calls and cumulative requested bytes, excluding setup. All fixtures run regardless of the Criterion timing filter.
allocation_command: compute bench --reason "Compare public intercept workspace reuse with benchmark-only composition" -- taskset -c 10 cargo bench --locked --bench fused_consumer --features faer,nalgebra,ndarray,sprs,zarrs -- '^consumer/(faer_csc|nalgebra_csc|sprs_csc)/2000x32/density_0.01/standardized/intercept/(workspace|composed_workspace)$' --warm-up-time 0.2 --measurement-time 0.8 --sample-size 20 --noplot
prototype_scope: Private InterceptWorkspace in benches/fused_consumer.rs; all library APIs remain unchanged.
timing_method: Criterion reported time estimates and intervals, in microseconds per ten least-squares steps; one CPU-pinned run.
compute_coordination: Exclusive compute bench window; public baseline and private prototype measured in one invocation.
